concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-payment-methods-wechat-pay-wechat-pay-in-app-payments-android-component]] — 2026-09-15 WeChat Pay in-app Android Component v5.0.0 add-on for existing Sessions or Advanced flows, with no extra method-specific fields/configuration and a no-test-platform/live-request qualification; earlier-version app-switch details are separate.
